verses.t: Uwiteka ni we mwungeri wanjye, sinzakena.
Nubwo nanyura mu kibaya cy'igicucu cy'urupfu, sinzatinya ikibi, kuko uri kumwe nanjye.
Imana ni yo buhungiro bwacu n'imbaraga zacu, ifashije cyane mu makuba.
Ntutinye kuko ndi kumwe nawe, ntiwihebe kuko ndi Imana yawe.
Kuko nzi imigambi mfite ku bwanyu, ni imigambi y'amahoro itari iy'ikibi, kugira ngo mbahe ibyiringiro mu minsi izaza.
Ahubwo mubanze mushake ubwami bw'Imana no gukiranuka kwayo, ibyo byose muzabihabwa.
Nimuze kuri jye mwese abananiwe n'abaremerewe, nanjye nzabaruhura.
Kuko Imana yakunze abari mu isi cyane, byatumye itanga Umwana wayo w'ikinege, kugira ngo umwizera wese atarimbuka, ahubwo agire ubugingo buhoraho.
Kuko Imana itatumye Umwana wayo mu isi ngo acire isi urubanza, ahubwo yamutumye ngo isi ikizwe na we.
Yesu aramubwira ati: Ni jye nzira n'ukuri n'ubugingo; nta wuza kwa Data atanyuzeho.
Tuzi yuko ku babakunda Imana, ibintu byose bifatanya gukora icyiza.
